authentication.description: X-API-Key header. Sign up via POST /v1/signup (key shown once, 100 starter credits); email verification is required before the key can create proposals.

description: Before an agent acts alone, get the quorum. One proposal, N approvals, one receipt. Approvers get one-time emailed links; at quorum a hash-chained receipt is issued.
limits: Quorum only: approvers decide whether the action should happen.
Not legal advice, not a safety judgement, not a wisdom judgement.
Proposals are created with a primary account key only.
name: ForgingStack Quorum

pricing.note: 1 credit per proposal; approvals are free. $10 for 1,000 credits via the billing checkout; credits land after payment is verified.

skills.description: Propose an action for quorum approval. Approvers get one-time emailed links; at quorum a receipt is issued.
skills.name: Create proposal

skills.description: A proposal by id, with its approval state and receipt id once approved.
skills.name: Get proposal

skills.description: Remaining credit balance for the API key.
skills.name: Get credits

skills.description: A past quorum receipt by id.
skills.name: Get receipt
